progress by combat group: the number a level-n member starts from (20 - progress), before AC and bonus
The four rates (2 per 3 levels, 1 per 2, 1 per 1, 1 per 3) are AD&D's priest, rogue, warrior and wizard rates [H]. The game hands them out in that order,
so a fighter improves like a priest and a cleric like a warrior [I]. Class to group: ds:116E; gain: ds:3610; levels per step: ds:3614.
